name: field
description: Shared layout primitive underlying labeled form fields (text field, picker, etc.).

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root of the component: sets the width and the spacing between the label, the field and the help text.

anatomy.name: field-label
anatomy.description: Text label that names the field, placed above or beside it.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Bordered box that frames the field content.

anatomy.name: help-text
anatomy.description: Description or error message shown below the field.

anatomyReview.notes: Owner decision D2 (2026-11-19): the root part container holds field-label, field and help-text; the bordered box is the field part (Figma Field, RSP FieldGroup). Shared primitive; Figma has no separate page and no source styles it. It has no relationship records yet; the input fields keep their own copies (decision D1a, a shared chrome component is bead 5m92.5.3.2).
